claims.statement: the Golay code has 4096 codewords
its minimum distance is 8
the code is self-dual and doubly even
covering radius 4; leader profile 1/24/276/2024/1771
every weight-4 coset has exactly 6 minimal leaders
the MOG alignment sends all 4096 codewords to hexacode words
the hexacode is [6,3,4] with 64 words
196,560 Leech minimal vectors in classes 1104/97152/98304
the column map F_2^4 <-> GF(4) x Z_4 is a bijection
the 24-bit codec round trip loses 0 bits
all library concepts survive Z^7 -> bits -> shadow -> Z^7
1168 of 4,782,969 dimension vectors are lawful
the mod-2 traps are accepted mod 2 and rejected exactly
the mod-2 ceiling measured over the library and the suite
target synthesis reproduces known answers, integer and rational
Buckingham-Pi groups are correct and the Pi count holds
code-automorphism membership is decided exhaustively
2^(1+24) relations hold in 4096D and fail in 24D
the snap product is associative (earlier claim corrected)
all arithmetic on the decision path is exact
the expression parser agrees with hand-computed dimensions
every +-2 exponent perturbation fools mod 2 and never fools Z^7
1.03% of pairs in [-2,2]^7 collapse mod 2; closed form = brute force
the fibre quaternions satisfy the Q8 relations; the fibre map is a bijection, not a homomorphism
the ordered fibre product is order-sensitive for part of the library
every closed walk has an integer winding number
holonomy is path-dependent and telescopes exactly
the v15-v19 conformal weight is exactly half the syndrome weight
22 syndrome-free dimension vectors in [-2,2]^7, each a codeword
the chromatic ground states are exactly the 4096 codewords
196,560 minimal vectors give 98,280 lines; 98,304 = 24 x 4096
the 300-dimensional Jordan layer is commutative, unital and non-associative

evidence.note: commutative, unital, non-associative, Jordan - the honest shape of the scalar + traceless-symmetric layer

claims.statement: the archive's 'Leech inner product' is 24 - 2 x Hamming distance
2^(1+24) : S_12 acts faithfully and homomorphically on 4096D

evidence.not_co1: Co_1 is not implemented; S_12 < O^+(24,2) is

claims.statement: the automorphisms found generate a 5-transitive group of order 244,823,040, transitive on the 759 octads
that group is all of Aut(C): the stabiliser of five points has exactly 48 elements, so Aut(C) = M24
the stabiliser chain decides membership exactly, agreeing with the exhaustive codeword test
M24 preserves every substrate decision about a carrier word and is transitive on the words of low weight
orbits on octads, dodecads and sextets give the maximal subgroup orders 322,560, 95,040 (= |M12|) and 138,240
the bit pattern is derived: every concept's word is encode(its meaning), decodes back to it, and cannot be set
composition cannot live on the carrier: the derived word map is not additive, and no F_2 encoder is injective
